combine_epinet_and_prior: combine an epinet with a prior function to produce a new epinet with scaled prior output
make_imagenet_mlp_prior: create an MLP-based prior function for ImageNet classification with configurable hidden sizes and ensemble count
make_imagenet_conv_prior: build a convolutional prior function for ImageNet with configurable output channels, kernel shapes, and strides
make_cifar_conv_prior: create a convolutional prior function for CIFAR-10 with configurable output channels and kernel shapes
review_priors_module: review the epinet priors module functions for combining epinets with prior functions for ImageNet and CIFAR
